name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
known_gaps: Common global layer only. REMA and ArcticDEM are the preferred polar surfaces. A DSM includes vegetation and structures where those exist.

name: Reference Elevation Model of Antarctica
spatial_resolution: 2 m strips and mosaics; coarser mosaics exist
license: Open with attribution; NSF and NGA collaboration
known_gaps: Antarctica to about 88 S, EPSG:3031. Does not cover Askja, Hawaii, or Devon Island.

name: ArcticDEM
temporal_coverage: Repeat stereo strips; mosaic epochs vary
license: Open with attribution, with stated exceptions for some recent Alaska data
known_gaps: Land north of 60 N. Covers Askja and Haughton. Does not cover the Dry Valleys or Hawaii.

name: EarthDEM
license: PGC access terms; confirm before redistribution
known_gaps: Land between about 60 S and 60 N. Useful for Mauna Loa. Askja at 65 N is outside this band.

name: USGS 3D Elevation Program
known_gaps: United States coverage, including Hawaii where lidar exists. Not a source for Antarctica, Iceland, or Devon Island.

name: Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance
known_gaps: Antarctic acquisitions are a seasonal campaign, not a 5-day global revisit. High-latitude scenes are limited by polar night, cloud, and low sun.

name: Landsat Collection 2
known_gaps: Polar scenes are summer-only and shadowed. Use as the optical archive where Sentinel-2 campaign coverage is thin.

name: MODIS MOD10A1 snow cover
known_gaps: Too coarse for the thin snow deposits that stabilize the University Valley ice table.

name: MODIS MOD11A1 land-surface temperature
known_gaps: Cloud gaps and 1 km mixing of valley floors and walls. Polar night removes winter observations.

name: NASA POWER climatology
temporal_coverage: Climatology and time series from MERRA-2 and related models
known_gaps: Not a substitute for McMurdo LTER stations or a measured ice table. Polar precipitation and valley-floor temperature are smoothed.

name: EMIT L2B mineral identification
known_gaps: The EMIT L3 catalog states observations between 52 N and 52 S. Mauna Loa can be covered. Askja, the Dry Valleys, and Haughton cannot. Empty pixels stay empty.

name: Global Lithological Map v1
spatial_resolution: Map polygons and a 0.5 degree grid
license: Cite Hartmann and Moosdorf 2012; confirm PANGAEA terms before redistribution
known_gaps: Sixteen first-level classes. Cannot separate pahoehoe from aa, sand-sheet facies, or hydrothermal settings.

name: Earth Impact Database
provider: Planetary and Space Science Centre, University of New Brunswick
known_gaps: Distance can be computed globally. The Haughton record page returned an error during Phase 1, so this catalog's crater center comes from Patterson and Ernst 2020.

name: McMurdo Dry Valleys LTER
provider: McMurdo Dry Valleys Long-Term Ecological Research
variable: Meteorology, soil, and hydrology at instrumented sites
license: LTER data policy; cite the dataset
known_gaps: Reference characterization for the Dry Valleys. These stations do not transfer to a global search.

name: Geologic map of the State of Hawaii
known_gaps: Site map for Hawaii lava units. Not a global layer. Flow names used later must come from this map.

name: Published Dyngjusandur facies descriptions
provider: Mountney and Russell 2004; Sara et al. 2017
license: Journal articles; figures are not a public raster
known_gaps: Not georeferenced in this catalog. Facies sites stay unlocated until a map is digitized from the papers.

name: Published Haughton geologic map
provider: Osinski et al. 2005a; Patterson and Ernst 2020 reproduction
license: Journal figure; not a survey download
known_gaps: Defines the hydrothermal and paleolake units. Not a global layer.

name: Sentinel-1 GRD backscatter
known_gaps: Alternate roughness only. Backscatter mixes slope, moisture, and ice. It is not geologic roughness and not a lava-tube map.
